scenes.status: The Guild Hall is quiet. Auby is already preparing today's records.
scenes.heading: A new adventure awaits.
scenes.note_message: Fresh parchment. Fresh tea. Fresh adventures. I had better find my good quill.
scenes.tea_message: Fresh tea has just been brewed.

scenes.status: Auby has already organised today's Guild Records. Mostly.
scenes.heading: Good morning, adventurer!
scenes.note_message: You're just in time. I have the Register open and I only misplaced one page this morning.
scenes.tea_message: The first proper pot of tea is ready.

scenes.status: Auby appears to be thinking very hard about something. Possibly cake.
scenes.heading: Someone has been busy.
scenes.note_message: I left your Guild Journal open for you. I was absolutely not reading it. Also, I found a copper coin under the desk. We should probably work out whose it is.

scenes.status: The lamps are lit, the records are filed, and the kettle is still warm.
scenes.heading: Welcome back to the Guild Hall.
scenes.note_message: I finished the last stack of records. Well... the last stack I am admitting exists.
scenes.tea_message: One last cup before the lamps go down?

scenes.status: Auby is still awake... somehow. The Guild Hall has gone wonderfully quiet.
scenes.heading: Burning the midnight oil?
scenes.note_message: Don't forget to get some sleep. This advice is aimed at both of us.
scenes.tea_message: Herbal tea only at this hour.

scenes.status: Please tread quietly. The Guild Hall never truly closes.
scenes.heading: Shhh... Auby is asleep.
scenes.note_message: If you need anything, leave me a note. If it is urgent... leave two notes.
scenes.tea_message: The tea has gone cold. Let him sleep.
